verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Docs Audit runs Linter rules across every page to find broken links, and Reviews/Branches let teams check changes with the AI Linter before anything reaches the live hub. The rdme CLI and Git-based PR workflows exist, but no evidence shows these checks running as a CI gate that blocks publishing. Missing for 10: documented CI-pipeline validation step (e.g. rdme validate in GitHub Actions), invalid-configuration/OpenAPI validation that blocks publish, broken-link checking wired into pre-publish CI rather than an in-app audit, independent or hands-on corroboration.
